assets.fx: That Unit Special Ability's range is increased by +4".
That Unit's ST Rating increases by +2.
The Crit Fail Rating for all of that Unit's Weapons is increased by +1, to a maximum of 20.
That Unit's Reposition movement distance is increased to 4".
Once per game, when rolling for Initiative in the Start Turn Phase, the opposing player may be forced to re-roll their result.
For one Turn per game, Friendly Units may perform Interact Actions as described in a Scenario or Secondary Objective even when Engaged with an Enemy Unit.
Once per game, designate up to two Enemy Units within 12" of each other and at least 8" from any Friendly Unit. For that Turn they may not perform Ambush or Counterattack Reactions.
For one Turn per game, when any Friendly Unit's Shoot Action Test results in a Critical Failure, the Unit does not receive a Reload Counter.
Once per game, before rolling for Initiative in any Turn after the first, this Force is considered to have rolled a "1".
Once per game, during the Activation of a Friendly Leader, that Unit may perform a Shoot Action using LD in place of MW with the Air Strike weapon profile.
This Unit is not deployed during Game Setup; it enters from a Battlefield edge other than Side A or Side B on its first Activation.
Once per game, identify a spot on the Battlefield. Remove all Reload Counters from all Friendly Units within 8" of that spot.
That Unit cannot be targeted by Strike or Shoot Actions with the Divine or Symmetry Weapon Special Abilities.
Friendly Networked Units may relocate Reaction Counters to this Unit even when it already possesses one, but no more than one.
This Unit may re-roll failed TN(LD) Tests performed as part of an Interact Action.

Once per game, when a Friendly Unit rolls a "20" on a Shoot or Strike Action Test, designate a Unit with non-Blocked LOS; for the rest of the game it does not suffer Critical Failure effects on a "20".
When determining Initiative each Turn, this Force does not include its current VPs when calculating its Initiative Score.
Each Turn, one Friendly Unit may perform a TN (LD) Test. On a Success, a Pinned Counter is removed from that Unit.
That Unit's Ceremonial Blades receive a x1 Damage Multiplier.
For one Turn per game, Friendly Units performing a Charge Action as their first Action gain +1 CC and ST for Strike Actions in that Charge.
When using Command (X), this Unit may select two Friendly Units per Action, provided both have the Trooper Designation.
Shoot Actions with this Weapon gain Continuous and Projected when targeting an Enemy Unit in Short Range.
Designate a Unit to receive Faith (1). If it already has Faith (X), X increases by +1.
This Unit may spend a Faith token to automatically Succeed on any TN (LD) Test, decided even after a Failure.
When that Unit performs a Charge Action, one Enemy Unit Engaged with it suffers an automatic DAM 7 hit before the Strike Action resolves.
When Activated with Wound Counters, before acting it may make a TN(10) Test; on a Success one Wound Counter is removed. Once per game.
That Unit's AR Rating increases by +1.
Adds to Command (X): spend an Action to grant Fierce Charge for the remainder of the Turn to a Friendly Unit within 12" and non-Blocked LOS.
For one Turn, all Enemy Units within 2" of this Unit receive a -2 penalty to CC, ST and LD.
That Unit gains +1 CC and MW and the Controller (3) Unit Special Ability, and is always within its own Controller (X) area of effect.
